hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Christensen-Oomen-Reno (arXiv 2601.08974, 2026): brief accelerating one-directional moves (drift bursts) are mostly followed by partial reversion, more so after negative bursts on high volume (Nagel 2012 liquidity-provision premium at minute horizons). Sign fixed: LONG after a high-volume negative burst, entered one bar after detection.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m, stype_in=continuous, <ROOT>.v.0, bought 2026-11-09 by batch job AFTER this registration (estimate row first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet, ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/. Times are America/New_York via zoneinfo. P(HH:MM) = CLOSE of the bar opening HH:MM-1min (last trade before HH:MM:00); if that bar is missing, the latest earlier bar within 5 minutes with the same instrument_id, else the observation is ineligible (counted). Any return uses two prices with the same instrument_id (roll rule ex ante). Trading days = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars), early closes skipped. EWMA sigma = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of the squared signal over the instrument's prior eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations (IS warm-up read first). Per root (ES, GC), full Globex session. r_t = ln(close_t/close_{t-1}) only if consecutive 1m bars with the same instrument_id and no gap > 1 minute (else the 10-bar window restarts). Slot = 30-minute ET slot of bar t; sigma_slot = RMS of 1m returns in that slot over the prior 20 eligible days (>= 10 days). z10_t = (sum of r over bars t-9..t)/(sigma_slot x sqrt(10)). V10_t = volume of bars t-9..t; vr_t = V10_t / median of V10 at the same bar-of-day over the prior 20 eligible days (>= 10). Burst at bar t iff z10_t <= -4.0 and vr_t >= 2.0. ENTRY at the OPEN of bar t+1; EXIT at the CLOSE of bar t+15 (15 minutes held); position LONG one contract. After an entry the root is blocked for 60 minutes. No entries from 16:00 to 18:30 ET (close, halt, reopen), none after Friday 16:00 ET, and none in the first 30 minutes after the Sunday reopen; an exit falling in a halt uses the last bar before it. Per-trade net bp of notional; trades of both roots pooled.
parameters: z threshold -4.0; volume ratio 2.0; hold 15 bars; cool-down 60 min; neighbours (fixed now): z -3.0 and -5.0; volume ratio 1.5 and 2.5; hold 11 and 19 bars; one-bar-delay = entry at the OPEN of bar t+2; volatility terciles = root trailing 20-day s.d. of daily close-to-close returns (IS bounds). Information only: positive-burst control arm (short), and bursts starting within 08:28-08:40, 09:58-10:10, 13:58-14:40 ET (scheduled releases; MFFU/Lucid news clauses).
instruments: CME ES and COMEX GC front futures (MES/MGC for sizing)
vol_scaler: none: one contract per trade, series in bp of notional
cost_model: per side: ES 0.30 pt x $50 + $2.50 inside 09:30-16:00 ET, 0.50 pt outside; GC 0.10 pt x $100 + $2.50 inside 08:20-13:30 ET, 0.20 pt outside; entry and exit; 2x run doubles.
notes: Evidence: abstract only (no magnitudes), so the prior is low and the economics are unmeasured; the paper's sample may include the OOS years (window not seen) - stated as a possible derivative window. Closed relatives: none closed; pre-sweep A-C20 (un-gated sibling) never registered. Plausibility low: the premium goes to those in the book during the burst; a one-minute-late taker gets the residue.

decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (IS read for warm-up first): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West lag 10 and the ET-date-clustered t of the net-1x per-event series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) PARAMETERS.md criteria 4 and 7: >= 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, >= 2 of 3 IS-bounded volatility terciles positive, every +-25% neighbour in parameters net-positive, the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team / re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Mechanical verdict: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3); NEAR-MISS if deciding t >= 2.6807 with bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL. Before the OOS read, on IS only: truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; decision unchanged), perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
